summary: The cut is clean, but the 129.09-129.33 strip is a heavy white-out that fades in with the turkey crowd changing to gold feathers, and the lower-left figure's frame-edge crop is a minor issue.

faults.what: Heavy bright cream wash-out over the whole frame fading down over about 10 frames; the background turkeys also swap from white with bow ties to flat gold feather shapes between 129.19 and 129.23, a sudden change in the crowd.
faults.fix: Smooth the flash decay and keep the crowd asset the same across the fade, or hide the swap under the peak of the white.

faults.what: Main figure is cropped at the head and the raised arm leaves frame, while the second figure is half cut off at the right edge; the pose reads as muddled, and confetti and feathers clutter the frame.
faults.fix: Reframe or tilt the camera to keep the head and arm in frame, and thin the confetti near the figures.

faults.what: Both figures use near-identical hip-lean and hands-on-hips poses in sync, which reads twinned and stiff, and the near figure's head is cut by the top edge.
faults.fix: Offset the second figure's timing or pose and lower the camera tilt so the head is in frame.
